blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Achieving cross-sensor generalization and arbitrary-scale reconstruction with a single model remains challenging in hyperspectral super-resolution (HSR). Although recent methods support arbitrary-scale reconstruction, applying them to new sensors or scales beyond the training range often requires additional data and computation to maintain reconstruction quality. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHSR, which predicts band-shared spatial operators rather than spectral values. Cross-Spectral Mapping (CSM) resamples inputs with any number of bands to fixed reference positions and predicts local operators with Gaussian supports. Continuous Operator-Field Reconstruction (COFR) composes these operators into a continuous field and applies them to all original bands for arbitrary-scale reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate that operator prediction outperforms direct spectral-value prediction on all seven datasets. Trained solely on ARAD with only 0.538M parameters, OmniHSR outperforms all directly transferred baselines on six unseen datasets without target-domain training data or adaptation. Across twelve upsampling factors from × 2 \times 2 to × 48 \times 48 , it improves average PSNR on Pavia U and Chikusei by 0.55 dB over the strongest baseline. It also surpasses baselines trained from scratch or adapted on the target sensor and achieves up to 36 × 36\times faster inference. Our code will be publicly released soon.
blocks.zh: 在超光谱超分辨率(HSR)中,实现跨传感器泛化和任意规模重建的单一模型仍然是一项挑战。 虽然最近的方法支持任意规模的重建,但将其应用到训练范围以外的新的传感器或尺度上,往往需要额外的数据和计算来维持重建质量. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出OmniHSR,预测波段共享的空间操作员,而不是光谱值。 跨谱绘图(CSM)将任何数量的波段输入重新标注到固定的参考位置,并预测有高斯支持的本地操作员. 连续操作员-现场重建(COFR)将这些操作员组成一个连续的作业场,并应用于所有原有的波段进行任意规模重建. 实验表明,操作者的预测在所有七个数据集上都超过了直接的光谱值预测. 仅在ARAD上训练,只有0.538M参数, OmniHSR在没有目标域培训数据或适应的情况下,在6个不见踪影的数据集上直接传输的基线都超过所有绩效. 在十二个抽样系数中,从x2 \time 2到x48\time 48,它使Pavia U和Chikusei的平均PSNR比最强基线提高了0.55 dB。 它还超过了从零开始训练或调整目标传感器的基线,并达到36x36xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 我们的密码很快就会公布

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Hyperspectral images provide rich spectral information but often lack sufficient spatial detail for practical applications, motivating hyperspectral image super-resolution (HSR) ( Bian et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Ciotola et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2023 ) . Most existing HSR methods are designed for fixed upsampling factors such as × 2 \times 2 , × 4 \times 4 , and × 8 \times 8 ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , while recent arbitrary-scale methods handle different factors with a single model ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024a ) . Hyperspectral sensors also differ in their band configurations, from 31 31 to more than one hundred bands, and the public data of a remote-sensing sensor is often a single scene. Achieving cross-sensor generalization and arbitrary-scale reconstruction with a single model remains challenging.
blocks.zh: 超光谱图像提供了丰富的光谱信息,但往往缺乏可用于实际应用的充分空间细节,激发了超光谱图像超分辨率(HSR)(Bian等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Ciotola等人,2025年;Guo等人,2023年)。 现有的HSR方法大多针对固定的采样因子设计,如×2\time2,×4\time4,和×8\time8(王等,2022年;张等,2023年;陈等. 2024b; Chen et al., 2025b),而最近的任意尺度方法用单一模型处理不同的因素(Chen et al., 2021; Hu et al., 2025; Jiang et al., 2024; Chen et al., 2024a). 超光谱传感器的波段配置也有所不同,从31段31段到100多个波段,遥感传感器的公共数据往往是单个场景. 以单一模式实现跨传感器的泛化和任意规模的重建仍然是挑战。

blocks.en: Existing HSR networks output the spectral values of every band, with as many output channels as the training sensor has bands (Figure 1 a). To serve a new sensor, they either run on sliding windows of bands, which multiplies the inference cost with the band count, or are trained from scratch or adapted on the target sensor ( Scheibenreif et al., 2024 ; Thoreau et al., 2025 ) , which needs target data (Figure 1 c). Beyond their training range of factors, fixed-scale methods must be retrained and arbitrary-scale methods lose accuracy. In all these cases, the network itself still predicts the spectral values, for every band and at every factor.
blocks.zh: 现有的HSR网络输出每个波段的光谱值,输出通道与训练传感器的波段一样多(图1a). 为了服务于一个新的传感器,它们要么运行在波段的滑动窗口上,从而将推断成本与波段计数相乘,要么从头开始训练或调整在目标传感器上(Scheibenreif等人,2024年;Thoreau等人,2025年),这需要目标数据(图1c)。 除了训练范围的因素外,必须重新训练固定规模方法,任意规模方法失去准确性。 在所有这些情况下,网络本身仍然预测每个波段和每个因素的光谱值。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose OmniHSR, which predicts band-shared spatial operators instead of spectral values (Figure 1 b). Every pixel of a low-resolution observation is a spatial mixture of the high-resolution spectra within its footprint, and all bands are mixed in the same way, so a high-resolution spectrum at any position can be approximated by combining the observed spectra around it, and the network only has to decide how they are combined. Such an operator carries no band dimension, so it acts on all bands of any sensor, and the network runs once regardless of the band count. Networks that predict filters for their input already work this way in denoising and video super-resolution ( Mildenhall et al., 2018 ; Jo et al., 2018 ) , for a fixed set of channels on a fixed output grid.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用OmniHSR,预测波段共享空间操作员而不是光谱值(图1b)。 低分辨率观测的每个像素都是其足迹中高分辨率光谱的空间混合物,所有波段都是以同样的方式混合的,因此任何位置的高分辨率光谱都可以通过将周围的观测到的光谱组合起来来进行近似化,网络只需要决定如何组合. 这样的操作员没有带子维度,因此它作用于任何传感器的所有带子,不管带子数多少,网络都会运行一次. 预测其输入过滤器的网络已经以这种方式在解密和视频超解析中发挥作用(Mildenhall等人,2018年;Jo等人,2018年),用于固定输出网格上的一组固定通道.

blocks.en: Predicting such operators for any sensor at any factor poses two difficulties. The network needs an input of fixed size while the band count changes with the sensor, and the operators are predicted on the low-resolution grid but must act on a target grid at any factor. Cross-Spectral Mapping (CSM) resamples an input with any number of bands to fixed reference positions and predicts, for every low-resolution pixel, a local operator with a Gaussian support ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . Continuous Operator-Field Reconstruction (COFR) composes these operators along their supports into a continuous field, evaluates it on the target grid at any factor, and applies it to all original bands.
blocks.zh: 预测任何传感器的操作人员都会遇到两个困难。 网络需要固定大小的输入,而波段数则随传感器变化,操作员在低分辨率网格上预测,但必须在任何因素下在目标网格上行动. Crosspectral Maging(CSM)将任何带数的输入重新标注到固定的参考位置,并预测每个低分辨率像素,一个有高斯支持的本地操作员(Kerbl等人,2023年;Hu等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年a). 连续操作员-现场重建(COFR)将这些操作员沿其支持构成一个连续的字段,按任何因素在目标网格上评价,并适用于所有原始波段.

blocks.en: With the backbone and training shared, predicting operators is more accurate than predicting spectral values on all seven datasets. Trained solely on the 31 31 -band ARAD ( Arad et al., 2022 ) with only 0.538 0.538 M parameters, OmniHSR outperforms all directly transferred baselines on six unseen datasets without target-domain training data or adaptation, and across twelve factors from × 2 \times 2 to × 48 \times 48 it improves the average PSNR on Pavia U ( Gamba, 2002 ) and Chikusei ( Yokoya & Iwasaki, 2016 ) by 0.55 0.55 dB over the strongest baseline. It also surpasses the baselines trained from scratch or adapted on the target sensor and runs up to 36 × 36\times faster on sensors with more than 31 31 bands (Figure 1 d). Our main contributions are as follows.
blocks.zh: 随着骨干和培训的共享,预测操作员比预测所有七个数据集的光谱值更准确. 仅在31-31波段ARAD(Arad等人,2022年)上受训,只有0.538 0.538 M参数,OmniHSR在没有目标域培训数据或适应的6个未见数据集上直接传输的基线都超过所有,跨越x2\time2到x48\time48的12个系数,它使Pavia U(Gamba,2002年)和Chikusei(Yokoya & Iwasaki,2016年)的平均PSNR比最强基线提高了0.55 0.55 dB. 它还超过了从零开始训练或调整在目标传感器上的基线,在超过31个波段(图1d)的传感器上运行速度可达36×36\时。 我们的主要贡献如下。

blocks.en: • We propose OmniHSR, a cross-sensor arbitrary-scale HSR framework that predicts band-shared spatial operators instead of spectral values, so that one model trained once serves unseen sensors at any factor zero-shot. • We propose CSM, which maps an input with any number of bands to fixed reference positions and predicts local operators with Gaussian supports, and COFR, which composes these operators into a continuous field and applies it to all original bands for arbitrary-scale reconstruction. • Experiments on seven datasets from six sensors show that, with the backbone and training shared, predicting operators is more accurate than predicting spectral values on every dataset, and that the zero-shot OmniHSR outperforms the baselines whether they are transferred directly, trained from scratch or adapted on the target sensor, and runs up to 36 × 36\times faster.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提出OmniHSR,这是一个跨传感器任意尺度的HSR框架,它预测波段共享的空间操作员而不是光谱值,这样就有一个经过训练的模型曾经在任何因素零射的情况下为看不见的传感器服务。 我们提出CSM,它将输入与任何数量的波段映射到固定的参考位置,并预测有高斯支持的本地操作员,而COFR则将这些操作员编成一个连续的字段,并应用于所有原始波段进行任意规模重建. · 对来自六个传感器的七个数据集的实验显示,在骨干和培训共享的情况下,预测操作员比预测每个数据集的光谱值更准确,零射出的OmniHSR无论是直接转移、从零开始训练还是在目标传感器上调整,其运行速度都快到36×36\时。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Single-image hyperspectral super-resolution has moved from grouped convolutional networks to attention, transformer and state-space designs ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . These networks are trained on one sensor at a time, and their last layer has as many channels as that sensor has bands. SQformer, SPG-ASSR and later methods ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) extend single-image hyperspectral super-resolution to arbitrary factors. For varying band counts, denoisers that run 3D convolutions or quasi-recurrent units along the spectral axis accept any band count, and models trained on 31-band natural scenes run on sensors with more bands ( Wei et al., 2021 ; Lai et al., 2023 ) . EigenSR ( Su et al., 2025 ) super-resolves the spatial eigenimages of a hyperspectral image with a pretrained RGB network, and MLSR ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) is guided by an RGB image and handles band sets sampled from 31-band datasets, with one model per factor. Remote-sensing foundation models accept different sets of channels through spatial-spectral tokens, wavelength-conditioned embeddings, hypernetworks or attention across channels for recognition and interpretation ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Baumann et al., 2026 ) . Fusion methods reach arbitrary factors or band counts with a high-resolution guide image ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , and high-pass filtering in pansharpening adds the high-pass detail of a panchromatic image to the resampled multispectral bands ( Chavez et al., 1991 ) . OmniHSR needs no wavelength, guide image or adaptation, covers any factor with one model, transfers from 31 to up to 145 bands, and its network outputs no spectral value.
blocks.zh: 单像超光谱超分辨率已经从组团式演化网络转移到注意,变压器和状态空间设计(王等人,2022年;张等人,2023年;陈等人,2024年b;陈等人,2025年b). 这些网络一次在一个传感器上训练,其最后一层的通道和传感器的波段一样多. SQFormer, SPG-ASSR和后来的方法(Jiang等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年a; Zhang et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2026) 将单像超光谱超分辨率扩展至任意因素. 对于不同的波段计数,沿光谱轴运行3D演化器或准经常性单元的Denoiser接受任何波段计数,在带数较多的传感器上运行的31波段自然场景上接受训练的模型(Wei等人,2021年;Lai等人,2023年). EigenSR(Su等人,2025年)超高频段图象的空间精度解,具有经过事先训练的RGB网络,MLSR(Zhang等人,2022年)以从31波段数据集取样的RGB图像和处理波段集为导,每个系数有一个模型. 遥感基础模型通过空间谱系符号、波长条件嵌入、超网络或跨渠道的注意力接受不同的渠道进行识别和解释(Hong等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年b;Baumann等人,2026年)。 聚变方法达到任意因子或波段计数,带有高分辨率的导线图像(Chen等人,2022年;Liang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年a),在泛沙尔平宁的高通滤波器将全色图像的高通细节添加到重印的多谱段(Chavez等人,1991年). OmniHSR不需要波长,引导图像或适应,包含任何一个模型的因子,从31段到145段的传输,其网络输出没有光谱值.

blocks.en: Meta-SR ( Hu et al., 2019 ) and ArbSR ( Wang et al., 2021 ) condition the upsampling layer on the factor, LIIF ( Chen et al., 2021 ) queries a local implicit function at continuous coordinates, and later work refines the query with texture estimation, learned ensembles, latent modulation, neural operators, normalizing flows and diffusion ( Lee & Jin, 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; He & Jin, 2024 ; Wei & Zhang, 2023 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) ; CUF ( Vasconcelos et al., 2023 ) learns continuous upsampling kernels inside such a network. Gaussian splatting represents a scene or an image with primitives of continuous spatial support ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and GaussianSR, GSASR and ContinuousSR ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Peng et al., 2026 ) predict 2D Gaussians from the low-resolution image and render them onto any target grid. These methods decode the value at a query position from network features into a number of channels fixed at training time. Predicting a filter and applying it to the input is established in dynamic filtering, burst denoising, video super-resolution and feature upsampling ( Jia et al., 2016 ; Mildenhall et al., 2018 ; Jo et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2019 ) . In joint image filtering, DKN ( Kim et al., 2021 ) makes each predicted kernel sum to zero, applies it to the bicubic-upsampled target and adds the result back, and it runs separately on each channel of a multi-channel target. LeRF ( Li et al., 2023 ) interpolates the input image with an anisotropic Gaussian predicted for every input pixel, and Wronski et al. (2019) merge a burst by splatting anisotropic kernels onto an arbitrary output grid. OmniHSR keeps the continuous support of the Gaussian primitives and lets every primitive carry one zero-sum operator, which is predicted from the low-resolution image alone and acts on every band of an unseen sensor following the band-shared prior.
blocks.zh: Meta-SR(Hu et al., 2019)和ArbSR(Wang et al., 2021)在系数上设定了检测层的条件,LIIF(Chen et al., 2021)在连续坐标上询问了局部隐含的功能,后来的工作用纹理估计,学习的共解,潜移,神经操作,使流量和扩散正常化(Lee & Jin, 2022;Cao et al., 2023;He & Jin, 2024;Wei & Zhang, 2023年;姚等人,2023年;高等人,2023年;徐等人,2025年);CUF. (Vasconcelos等人,2023年)在这样的网络中学习不断提高内核的样本. 高斯滑板代表了具有连续空间支持的原始物的场景或图像(Kerbl等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2024年),以及高斯SR,GSASR和连续SR(Hu等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年a;Peng等人,2026年)从低分辨率图像中预测2D高斯人,并将其制成任何目标网格. 这些方法将查询位置的值从网络特性解码为训练时固定的若干频道. 在动态滤波,爆破解析,视频超解析和特征提升样本中建立过滤并应用于输入(Jia等人,2016年;Mildenhall等人,2018年;Jo等人,2018年;Wang等人,2019年). 在联合图像过滤中,DKN(Kim等人,2021年)将每个预测的内核和为0,应用到双立方体放大标的上,并增加结果回放,在多通道标的的每个通道上分别运行. LeRF(Li et al., 2023)将输入图像与每个输入像素预测的异位素高斯素插在一起,而Wronski et al.(2019)将一个通过将异位素内核镀在任意输出网格上的突起合并. OmniHSR保持高斯原始人的持续支持,让每个原始人携带一个零和操作员,这个操作员是从低分辨率图像中单独预言的,并在乐队共享之前的每一个未见传感器的带上行动.

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en: Cross-sensor arbitrary-scale HSR reconstructs a high-resolution hyperspectral image Y ^ ∈ ℝ s ​ h × s ​ w × B \hat{Y}\in\mathbb{R}^{sh\times sw\times B} from a low-resolution observation X ∈ ℝ h × w × B X\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times B} , where the band number B B varies across sensors and the scale factor s s is arbitrary. OmniHSR aims to build a unified model that generalizes across different band configurations and generates outputs at arbitrary scales.
blocks.zh: 跨传感器任意尺度 HSR 重建高分辨率的超光谱图像 Y ^ ^ R s h × s → B → hat{ Y →in\ mathbb{ R}^{sh\times sw\times B}从低分辨率观测 X → R h → w → B → in\ mathbb{ R}^{h\times w\times B}中,波段编号 B 在不同传感器之间有差异,比例系数 s 是任意的. OmniHSR旨在构建一个统一的模型,将不同的波段配置概括起来,并以任意的尺度生成输出.

blocks.en:
OmniHSR consists of two modules, Cross-Spectral Mapping (CSM) and Continuous Operator-Field Reconstruction (COFR), and its overall pipeline is illustrated in Figure 2 . Specifically,
First, CSM resamples X X along the band axis to a fixed number M M of bands, feeds the result to an encoder and predicts h ​ w hw 2D Gaussian primitives conditioned on the factor s s . blocks.en: OmniHSR is trained on the 900 ARAD training images alone, and the other six datasets, CAVE ( Yasuma et al., 2010 ) , Harvard ( Chakrabarti & Zickler, 2011 ) , Pavia U and Pavia C ( Gamba, 2002 ) , Chikusei ( Yokoya & Iwasaki, 2016 ) and Botswana ( Ham et al., 2005 ) , serve only for testing. blocks.en: We compare with six arbitrary-scale methods, the factor-conditioned Meta-SR ( Hu et al., 2019 ) , the coordinate-query methods LIIF ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , LTE ( Lee & Jin, 2022 ) , CiaoSR ( Cao et al., 2023 ) and SRNO ( Wei & Zhang, 2023 ) , and the Gaussian-based GaussianSR ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . They use the ESSAformer encoder ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) of OmniHSR at twice its width or more and are trained on ARAD for 2000 epochs. Their output dimension equals the training band count, so on a new sensor they run on sliding windows of 31 31 adjacent bands, with no target-domain training. We also train every baseline on the target scene of Pavia U and Chikusei, from scratch or through two 1 × 1 1{\times}1 band adapters on its frozen ARAD body, and test it on tiles that do not overlap the training tiles.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper shows that success in cross-sensor HSR depends on what the network outputs. With the backbone and training shared, a network that outputs spectral values is less accurate than one that predicts band-shared spatial operators on every dataset, even when it serves any band count (Section 4.3 ), and adapting its interface or training it on the target sensor still leaves it less accurate than a model that has never seen that sensor (Section 4.2 ). OmniHSR only decides how the observed pixels are combined, transfers from the 31 31 bands of ARAD to sensors with up to 145 145 bands without target data (Table 4 ), and keeps its lead at factors far beyond its training range (Table 1 ). The spectrum of a new sensor is already in its observation, and what is worth learning is how its pixels are combined in space. One operator shared by all bands assumes that they share their spatial blur and registration, and bands that differ in either call for operators that vary across bands. The low-resolution inputs in this paper are all synthesized, and real or noisy observations remain to be tested.
blocks.zh: 本文显示,跨传感器HSR的成功取决于网络输出什么. 通过共享主干线和培训,输出光谱值的网络不如预测每个数据集上的波段共享空间操作员的网络准确,即使它服务于任何波段计数(第4.3节),并且调整其界面或对目标传感器的培训仍然比从未见过该传感器的模型更准确(第4.2节)。 OmniHSR只决定观测到的像素如何结合,从ARAD的31个波段转移到没有目标数据的最多145个波段的传感器上(表4),并保持其领先因素远远超出其训练范围(表1). 新传感器的频谱已经在它的观测中,值得学习的是它的像素如何在空间中结合. 所有波段共用的一个操作员假定它们共享空间模糊和注册,而波段在要求各波段不同的操作员时都有所不同。 本文中的低分辨率投入都是合成的,真实或吵闹的观测结果仍有待测试.

blocks.en: All experiments use the seven public datasets listed in Appendix A , with the crops, the bicubic degradation and the metrics described in Section 4.1 . The same appendix specifies the parameterization of the primitives, the rendering width, the losses and their weights, the operator window, the initialization and the random seed of OmniHSR, and Section 4.1 gives its optimizer, learning-rate schedule and number of epochs. blocks.en: Figure 4 and Table 6 compare the three ways to use a baseline on a new sensor. They keep the protocol of the target-trained baselines, the 64 × 64 64{\times}64 test tiles of Pavia U and Chikusei that do not overlap their training tiles, with a low-resolution side of round ⁡ ( 64 / s ) \mathrm{round}(64/s) . Direct transfer runs the ARAD model on sliding windows of 31 adjacent bands and averages the overlaps, with no target-domain training. Training from scratch follows each method’s original recipe on the target scene for 2000 epochs. Adapter tuning freezes the ARAD body, attaches one 1 × 1 1{\times}1 convolution before it and one after it to convert the band count, trains only these two layers from an exact linear band resampling, and runs until the learning rate has annealed.

blocks.en: Figure 4 averages each way over the seven factors from × 3.5 \times 3.5 to × 16 \times 16 , taking the best of the six baselines at each factor. Adapter tuning is the strongest of the three ways, and the zero-shot OmniHSR stays above it by 0.21 dB on Pavia U and by 0.60 dB on Chikusei. It also has the highest PSNR of all eighteen configurations at every factor, by 0.03 to 1.03 dB. Direct transfer lifts the stronger methods above bicubic interpolation at small factors, and all six methods fall below it at × 12 \times 12 on Pavia U and at × 16 \times 16 on both scenes. Training from scratch leaves all six methods below direct transfer of the same model at × 12 \times 12 on Chikusei, most for SRNO at 22.87 against 24.60 dB. Adapter tuning lifts every method, and the size of the lift is almost entirely set by the starting point, with a correlation of − 0.93 -0.93 between the two at × 4 \times 4 on Pavia U and − 0.99 -0.99 on Chikusei. After adapter tuning, LIIF remains below bicubic interpolation at all seven factors on Chikusei, and only Meta-SR among the six methods is above it at × 12 \times 12 on Pavia U and at × 16 \times 16 on both scenes.

blocks.en: C.1 Testing the Band-Shared Operator Prior
blocks.zh: C.1 带状共享运算符前置测试

blocks.en: Table 11 tests the band-shared operator prior of Section 3.1 without any network. The images, crops and degradation are those of the seven-dataset evaluation (Section 4.1 and Table 12 ). For every image and factor s ∈ { 2 , 4 } s\in\{2,4\} , we describe Y b Y_{b} in every window of 16 × 16 16\times 16 low-resolution pixels by Eq. ( 3 ), with a zero-sum 5 × 5 5\times 5 operator 𝐤 \mathbf{k} of 24 24 free coefficients. The low-resolution pixels of a window are split into two halves in a checkerboard pattern; 𝐤 \mathbf{k} is fitted by least squares with a small ridge term on the high-resolution pixels of one half and evaluated on the other half, so no high-resolution pixel is used for both.

A shared operator is fitted on a subset of the bands, either one band, four interior bands evenly spaced over the spectrum, or the first half of the spectrum, and is applied unchanged to all bands outside the subset. As the reference, a per-band operator is fitted for every band on the same pixels. The gain of an operator is 10 ​ log 10 10\log_{10} of the ratio between the squared errors of bicubic interpolation and of the operator, where the errors are accumulated over all windows and evaluated bands of an image and the gains are averaged over the images.
blocks.zh: 共享运算符安装在波段的子集上,要么一个波段,四个内带在谱面上均匀间隔,要么是前半段,并且对子集之外的所有波段应用不变. 作为参考,在同一像素上的每个波段都配备了每个波段的操作员。 一个操作员的收益是10 log 10\log\ 10} 双曲线插值与操作员的平方差错之比, 在所有窗口上累积错误, 并评估图像的波段, 收益平均在图像上 。

blocks.en: An operator fitted on four bands is at least as accurate as the per-band operators on all seven datasets at both factors, and an operator fitted on the first half of the spectrum serves the second half equally well on all datasets except CAVE. These two operators are fitted on more pixels than a per-band operator, which explains their slight advantage. The one-band operator is fitted on as many pixels as a per-band operator, so its column separates the sharing from the number of fitting pixels. It loses at most 0.01 dB on six datasets, while on CAVE it loses 0.29 dB at × 2 \times 2 and 0.13 dB at × 4 \times 4 , so the operator should be determined from several bands spread over the spectrum, which the fixed band positions of CSM provide. The per-band gains, 0.2 to 1.2 dB, come from a linear operator fitted per window and serve only as the reference for sharing. The operators of OmniHSR form a finer class, one for every primitive placed with a Gaussian support, and this test covers the coarser class of one operator per window.

blocks.en: C.8 What the Network Predicts

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows the primitives and operators that OmniHSR predicts at × 4 \times 4 on crops of ARAD and Chikusei chosen as in Appendix B.2 . At edges the supports stretch along the edge. We call a primitive an edge primitive when the gradient magnitude of the band-averaged ground truth at its low-resolution pixel is in the top 10%, and a flat primitive when it is in the bottom half. Among the edge primitives with an axis ratio of at least 1.2, the long axis lies within 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} of the edge direction for 98.5% on ARAD and 94.8% on Chikusei. The median axis ratio is 3.9 at edges and 1.3 in flat regions on ARAD, and 3.8 and 1.6 on Chikusei. The operators concentrate on edges as well, with a median norm of 3.5 at edges and 0.9 in flat regions on ARAD and 2.8 and 1.4 on Chikusei, so the correction to bicubic interpolation is small away from edges.
